answer: Each identity claims one shale pile at a wharf, locks a 70-credit bond, and paints a saffron band at surveyed depth. Each epoch it files a key-signed load reading: load and settlement in millimetres. An auditor recomputes settlement from the shale pile load table by diameter, depth; over 3% deviation, a reused serial, or a shared pile burns the bond. First survey costs 38; the k-th fake needs a new pile at 38+6(k-1); the 1000th pays 6032, 1000 fakes 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-pile ring fails: one cell cannot fake distinct settlements. An honest agent pays 38 once, bond kept.
